name: Linux Kernel, Drivers & Hardware Layer
description: Direct kernel-layer visibility and control for AriaOS: live kernel/PSI/thermal telemetry, dmesg ring buffer diagnostics, PCI/USB/network topology, sysctl inspection/tuning, and kernel module (modprobe) management.

tools.name: kernel_telemetry
tools.description: Read Linux kernel version, cmdline, Pressure Stall Information (CPU/mem/IO), thermal zones, and loaded modules count.

tools.name: dmesg_inspect
tools.description: Inspect recent Linux kernel ring buffer logs (dmesg) filtered by severity or line limit.

level.description: Optional dmesg level filter (e.g. err, warn, emerg,crit,err).

tools.name: hardware_pci_usb
tools.description: Enumerate physical PCI devices (GPU, NVMe, NIC), USB devices, and kernel network interfaces/routes.

tools.name: sysctl_read
tools.description: Read one or more live Linux kernel sysctl parameters (e.g. vm.swappiness, kernel.ostype).

tools.name: sysctl_write
tools.description: Modify a live Linux kernel sysctl parameter at runtime.

value.description: New value to apply cleanly via sysctl -w.

tools.name: kernel_module_manage
tools.description: Load or unload a Linux kernel module/driver using modprobe.

module.description: Kernel module name (e.g. vfio_pci, loop, wireguard).
